_about.purpose: Per-model record of how each of the nine benchmarked architectures was actually served.
_about.why_this_file_exists: docs/ERRATA.md B10: Gemma-2-9B, Mistral-Nemo-12B, Llama-3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B and Llama-3.2-11B cannot be served in fp16 on 16 GB and were therefore quantised, but the manuscript reports no format or bit width for any of them. Quantisation materially affects both output quality and script integrity, so an unrecorded quantisation is a confound running through the entire nine-model benchmark of Tables V, VI and VII.
_about.how_to_use: Fill quantisation, runtime, revision and served_on for every model before citing any cross-model comparison. Fields marked FILL are unverified. The presence of llama_cpp/ in this repository indicates GGUF for at least some models, but which ones, and at what bit width, is not recorded anywhere in the repository or the paper.

schema.model_id: Hugging Face id, GGUF filename, or local path as served
schema.parameters_b: billions of parameters, per Table I
schema.quantisation: one of: fp16 | bf16 | nf4 | int8 | Q4_K_M | Q5_K_M | Q8_0 | FILL
schema.revision: commit hash or GGUF build; a model id alone is not a version
schema.context_length: max context used at benchmark time
schema.vram_gb: measured resident VRAM, or null if not measured
schema.role: what the model was used for in the paper
schema.served_on: ISO date the generations in benchmarks/raw/ were produced
schema.notes: anything that would change how a reader reads the numbers

decoding._source: Paper Sec. IV-C. Held constant across all nine models so comparisons are not confounded by sampling.

latency_measurements._note: docs/ERRATA.md B3: Sec. V-C's 1450 ms / 69 tok/s and 680 ms / 147 tok/s both imply a 100-token budget, not the 256 used for quality evaluation. Latency figures must be compared only against other figures at the same budget.

benchmark_execution._source: bhasha/llm/run_benchmark_suite.py + the 'Ollama Backend' header in llm outputs/*.md
benchmark_execution.quantisation_note: This answers the question docs/ERRATA.md B10 left open. The nine-model benchmark was served at Q4_K_M GGUF, NOT the 4-bit NF4 via BitsAndBytes that Sec. III-C and Sec. IV-A describe. The benchmarked and fine-tuned configurations therefore differ. See ERRATA C11.
benchmark_execution.decoding_note: Temperature was 0.3, not the 0.7 of Sec. IV-C. See ERRATA C13.
benchmark_execution.n_note: Four prompts total, one per category, so N=1 per task per model. Tables V and VI rest on a single item each. See ERRATA C12.
benchmark_execution.prompt_defect: The OCR-Fix prompt embeds its own expected answer, so that task measures copying rather than correction. See ERRATA C17.
